topic.source_contract: CIL charging liability relief commencement payment infrastructure funding statement delivery

scope_guards: A charging schedule is not treated as a site liability calculation.
A liability notice is not treated as payment.
CIL receipt is not treated as completed infrastructure.
An Infrastructure Funding Statement priority is not treated as a funded project commitment.
CIL and section 106 obligations are not silently conflated.
A relief claim is not treated as granted relief.
An appeal is not treated as suspended or successful without the formal outcome.
No score or promotion is written without exact permission, liable area, notices, relief, commencement, payment and infrastructure-delivery evidence.
